verdict.rationale: Figma's marketing docs mention publishing/centralizing libraries and assets across teams (figma-docs-12, figma-docs-37) and general component-to-code guidance (figma-docs-30), implying shared library publishing exists, but no evidence details the controlled-update workflow (e.g., update notifications, accept/reject changes, library version history for components) that the story specifically asks about. missing for 10: documentation of library update notifications/controlled push mechanism, component override handling, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the update-control workflow.
